u: The two names are aliases for qemu-system-x86_64, where kvm-spice enables kvm native hardware mode by default. These names are kept for backward compatibility wih old package, when spice-enabled qemu were packaged separately. Now main qemu-system has spice functionality built in. Please use qemu-system-x86_64 instead of the old compat names.
